subject.title: Anthropic Max usage alert text blocks delivered as assistant messages to channels

question: Should Anthropic Max usage alerts be stripped and discarded, stripped and privately captured as quota metadata, or handled through a new configurable output-strip surface?
rationale: All three paths can stop the channel leak, but they differ on privacy, future quota UX, and whether OpenClaw adds a broad config surface.

options.title: Strip and privately capture
options.body: Remove Anthropic Max billing alerts before transcripts/channels and retain only owner-approved private quota metadata for future throttling or status use.

options.title: Targeted strip-only
options.body: Remove matching Anthropic Max alert text before persistence and delivery, accepting that server-truth quota data is discarded for now.

options.title: Configurable strip patterns
options.body: Add a user-configurable output strip surface, but only after maintainers accept the extra config/security contract.

recommendation.title: Strip and privately capture
recommendation.body: Remove Anthropic Max billing alerts before transcripts/channels and retain only owner-approved private quota metadata for future throttling or status use.

likelyOwner.reason: The likely fix crosses Anthropic transport and session/runtime handling, where vincentkoc has the strongest recent path history.
